title: Arrows can be drawn in hand-made styles, not only mechanical ones
goal: User 2026-10-01: 'I would like the arrow tool to have more stylized options... It is extremely mechanical now.' Four references saved in docs/design/references/arrows/: user-ref-25 (a thin hand-drawn curved line with an open hooked head), user-ref-26 (a rough charcoal/marker outline arrow, double-stroked and textured), user-ref-27 (a bold curved stroke with a loose open head), user-ref-28 (a brush stroke that tapers thin at the tail, swells in the middle and ends in a calligraphic swept head). Today arrows have ArrowheadStyle (PhotonzCore/ArrowheadStyle.swift) and straight/curved paths: geometric, uniform width. Compare with Skitch, CleanShot X and Excalidraw's hand-drawn arrows.
notes: Filed from the intake window. References are the user's own images.
acceptance: A Style choice for arrows, shown as visual preset tiles drawn in the real renderer (not words): Clean (today), Hand-drawn (25: thin, slightly irregular line, open hooked head), Marker (27: bold rounded stroke, loose open head), Brush (28: tapered tail, swelling body, swept calligraphic head), Sketch (26: rough double-stroked outline arrow with a dry-ink texture); each matched against its reference side by side in the audit

Styles are non-destructive render-time properties of the arrow (PhotonzCore model + tests first; the arrow keeps its start, end and bend), so switching style keeps the arrow's path, colour and width, and undo works

Hand-made styles never wobble between renders: their irregularity comes from a per-arrow seed stored on the arrow, so the same arrow looks identical in the canvas, after reopen and in export; a Reshuffle action (right-click) picks a new seed
Every style follows the curve when the arrow is bent, scales its detail with the width, and stays crisp at any zoom and in export at 1x/2x/3x; Brush tapers and swells along the path's length
Colour, width and opacity still apply; Sketch's texture and Brush's taper look right on dark and light pictures
The style tiles live where arrow options already are (tool options and the arrow's properties), using the design system's tile component; the last used style sticks for the next arrow
Walk at Next defaults draws one arrow of each style, straight and bent, and photographs them next to the four references

log.note: Adversarial review before building: (1) arrows cannot bend at all today (AnnotationContent holds start/end only, the rasterizer draws a straight line), yet 3 of the 4 references are curved and two acceptance items need bent arrows. Filed the prerequisite arrows-can-be-bent-by-dragging-their-middle (p1, seq 29); the styles here are written against a spine that already takes a quadratic curve so the bend only has to supply a control point. (2) Each reference has its OWN head (hooked V, loose two-stroke V, swept calligraphic wings, outline triangle), so for the hand-made styles the head is part of the style: the Ending picker and the tail's Ends row apply to Clean only; Head Size, both colours and Thickness apply to every style. (3) Premiere/Keynote/Skitch users expect a style as a picked look, not settings: one row of picture tiles above the arrow's parts, and the same tiles in the arrow tool's popover. (4) Irregularity must be stable: a stored per-arrow seed, the next arrow gets a fresh one, Reshuffle in the right-click menu. (5) Texture must stay vector so it is crisp at any zoom and in SVG: the Sketch dry-ink look is broken strokes, not a bitmap noise.

Audit rough items: bend -> folded into arrows-can-be-bent-by-dragging-their-middle (its acceptance names every style following the curve and a bent walk). Sketch texture subtler than ref 26, brush wings shorter than ref 28 at Head Size 1.0, tiles in panel ink rather than the arrow's colour, Ending/Ends rows hidden for hand-made: left for the user's reaction on the audit, no task. arrow-reshuffle-walk could not run (screen locked all session, twice tried); Reshuffle is covered by ArrowStyleTests.reshufflingChangesOnlyTheSeed. Found and fixed on the way: VideoKit.TileGrid trapped (Int of infinity) on an unbounded width offer, caught by the probe crashing.

Shipped 9b94fbe7: Clean, Hand-drawn, Marker, Brush and Sketch arrow styles (PhotonzCore ArrowStyle/HandMadeArrow, 28 core + 8 render tests), seeded per arrow so they never wobble, Reshuffle on right-click and Layer menu, Style tiles drawn by the real rasterizer in Appearance and the tool popover, live drag preview, SVG/1x/2x/3x export. Verified: Scripts/test.sh green (10847 tests), arrow-styles-walk green at Next defaults with real captures beside the four references, on light and dark. Bent arrows do not exist yet: that half moved to the prerequisite arrows-can-be-bent-by-dragging-their-middle (p1, seq 29). Audit queue/audits/2026-10-01-arrow-styles.json.
